    • build

      public static Llama build(String checkpointDir, String tokenizerPath, int maxBatchSize, int maxSeqLen, byte deviceId) throws IOException
      Builds a Llama instance by initializing and loading a model checkpoint.

      Supports two on-disk layouts:

      • Meta — params.json plus consolidated.*.pt shards.
      • HuggingFace — config.json plus *.safetensors (optionally indexed by model.safetensors.index.json).
      Parameters:
      checkpointDir - the directory path of checkpoint files.
      tokenizerPath - the path of tokenizer model file.
      maxBatchSize - the maximum batch size for inference.
      maxSeqLen - the maximum sequence length for input text.
      deviceId - the optional CUDA device ID. If negative, don't use CUDA.
      Returns:
      an instance of Llama model.
      Throws:
      IOException - if fail to open model checkpoint.

    • build

      public static Llama build(String checkpointDir, String tokenizerPath, int maxBatchSize, int maxSeqLen, byte deviceId, double memFractionStatic) throws IOException
      Builds a Llama instance by initializing and loading a model checkpoint.

      When memFractionStatic > 0, a KvCachePool is allocated after weight loading with SGLang --mem-fraction-static semantics: y is a fraction of total GPU memory for the static region (weights + KV); see smile.chat.mem-fraction-static in smile-serve.

      Parameters:
      checkpointDir - the directory path of checkpoint files.
      tokenizerPath - the path of tokenizer model file.
      maxBatchSize - the maximum batch size for inference.
      maxSeqLen - the maximum sequence length for input text.
      deviceId - the optional CUDA device ID. If negative, don't use CUDA.
      memFractionStatic - static-region fraction of total GPU memory for weights + KV; <= 0 keeps the default test-sized pool.
      Returns:
      an instance of Llama model.
      Throws:
      IOException - if fail to open model checkpoint.

    • build

      public static Llama build(String checkpointDir, String tokenizerPath, int maxBatchSize, int maxSeqLen, byte deviceId, double memFractionStatic, String kvCacheDtype) throws IOException
      Builds a Llama instance by initializing and loading a model checkpoint.

      When memFractionStatic > 0, a KvCachePool is allocated after weight loading with SGLang --mem-fraction-static semantics: y is a fraction of total GPU memory for the static region (weights + KV); see smile.chat.mem-fraction-static in smile-serve.

      Parameters:
      checkpointDir - the directory path of checkpoint files.
      tokenizerPath - the path of tokenizer model file.
      maxBatchSize - the maximum batch size for inference.
      maxSeqLen - the maximum sequence length for input text.
      deviceId - the optional CUDA device ID. If negative, don't use CUDA.
      memFractionStatic - static-region fraction of total GPU memory for weights + KV; <= 0 keeps the default test-sized pool.
      kvCacheDtype - optional KV-cache element dtype name (e.g. bfloat16, float16); null/blank uses torch_dtype from config.json, then the CUDA compute dtype.
      Returns:
      an instance of Llama model.
      Throws:
      IOException - if fail to open model checkpoint.

    • build

      public static Llama build(String checkpointDir, String tokenizerPath, int maxBatchSize, int maxSeqLen, byte deviceId, double memFractionStatic, String kvCacheDtype, int pageSize) throws IOException
      Builds a Llama instance by initializing and loading a model checkpoint.

      When memFractionStatic > 0, a KvCachePool is allocated after weight loading with SGLang --mem-fraction-static semantics: y is a fraction of total GPU memory for the static region (weights + KV); see smile.chat.mem-fraction-static in smile-serve.

      Parameters:
      checkpointDir - the directory path of checkpoint files.
      tokenizerPath - the path of tokenizer model file.
      maxBatchSize - the maximum batch size for inference.
      maxSeqLen - the maximum sequence length for input text.
      deviceId - the optional CUDA device ID. If negative, don't use CUDA.
      memFractionStatic - static-region fraction of total GPU memory for weights + KV; <= 0 keeps the default test-sized pool.
      kvCacheDtype - optional KV-cache element dtype name (e.g. bfloat16, float16); null/blank uses torch_dtype from config.json, then the CUDA compute dtype.
      pageSize - tokens per radix / KV pool page (>= 1).
      Returns:
      an instance of Llama model.
      Throws:
      IOException - if fail to open model checkpoint.

    • build

      public static Llama build(String checkpointDir, String tokenizerPath, int maxBatchSize, int maxSeqLen, byte deviceId, double memFractionStatic, String kvCacheDtype, int pageSize, int modelLoaderThreads) throws IOException
      Builds a Llama instance by initializing and loading a model checkpoint.

      When memFractionStatic > 0, a KvCachePool is allocated after weight loading with SGLang --mem-fraction-static semantics: y is a fraction of total GPU memory for the static region (weights + KV); see smile.chat.mem-fraction-static in smile-serve.

      Parameters:
      checkpointDir - the directory path of checkpoint files.
      tokenizerPath - the path of tokenizer model file.
      maxBatchSize - the maximum batch size for inference.
      maxSeqLen - the maximum sequence length for input text.
      deviceId - the optional CUDA device ID. If negative, don't use CUDA.
      memFractionStatic - static-region fraction of total GPU memory for weights + KV; <= 0 keeps the default test-sized pool.
      kvCacheDtype - optional KV-cache element dtype name (e.g. bfloat16, float16); null/blank uses torch_dtype from config.json, then the CUDA compute dtype.
      pageSize - tokens per radix / KV pool page (>= 1).
      modelLoaderThreads - safetensors loader threads; 0 = auto (SafeTensorsLoaderThreads.resolve(int, int)).
      Returns:
      an instance of Llama model.
      Throws:
      IOException - if fail to open model checkpoint.

    • generate

      public ChatCompletion generate(int[] prompt, int maxGenLen, double temperature, double topp, boolean logprobs, long seed, GenerationListener listener, BooleanSupplier cancelRequested)
      Generates a text completion from a tokenized prompt using nucleus sampling.
      Specified by:
      generate in interface LanguageModel
      Parameters:
      prompt - tokenized prompt.
      maxGenLen - maximum number of new tokens to generate.
      temperature - temperature value for controlling randomness in sampling.
      topp - top-p probability threshold for nucleus sampling.
      logprobs - flag indicating whether to compute token log probabilities.
      seed - optional RNG seed to sample deterministically; 0 is non-deterministic.
      listener - optional generation progress callback.
      cancelRequested - when non-null and returns true, generation stops between decode steps with CancellationException.
      Returns:
      the generated text completion.

    • prefillChunk

      public Tensor prefillChunk(int requestId, int[] prompt, int from, int to)
      Prefills prompt[from, to) into the KV cache (exclusive activate). Returns last-token logits only when to == prompt.length; otherwise null (intermediate chunk).
      Specified by:
      prefillChunk in interface ModelExecutor
      Parameters:
      requestId - KV request id.
      prompt - full prompt tokens.
      from - start position (usually matched prefix, possibly trimmed).
      to - exclusive end (<= prompt.length).
      Returns:
      logits [1, vocab] or null.
